svg.title: edit_model — every gate, check and branch in one call
svg.desc: Calls are memoized by parsed arguments. A new call reads its immutable question, named model base and optional check panel; no panel means no predictive check. Specification, identification, compatibility and predictive checks run when their inputs change. The model and findings commit together. Failures retain an attempt and can be retried.
